pending.body: In shrimp.rs, four private helper functions (shrimp_feeding, update_condition, update_molt_stress, emit_molt_stress_warning) still accept a `_volume_l: f64` parameter that is now dead code — each function either calls `state.water_volume_l()` or uses TankState concentration helpers internally. Remove the unused parameter from these private functions to avoid confusion and dead-code drift. The caller `step_daily_shrimp` already computes `volume_l` but it is only used as a zero-check guard; the helpers no longer need it passed in.

In nitrogen_cycle.rs line 83, the decomposer DO Monod term uses a hardcoded half-saturation constant (`do_total / (do_total + 2.0)`) with a comment '// half-sat ~2 mg total'. This constant should be extracted into ProcessParams (e.g., `decomposer_k_do_mg`) alongside the existing `decomposer_k_doc_mg`, so it is tunable and consistently documented. Currently it is the only hardcoded Monod K constant in the nitrogen cycle; all other guilds (AOB, NOB, comammox) have their K values in ProcessParams.

Fix the zero-volume startup override path in `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:546-600`. When `source_water_profile_id` is `None`, substrate-only overrides rescale the existing totals instead of rebuilding from the scenario’s source water. That breaks as soon as the original materialized state has `old_volume_l <= f64::EPSILON`: `WaterState::rescale_totals_for_volume` in `crates/tank_core/src/types/water.rs:179-184` returns a zero scale in that case, so switching to a shallower substrate after a low-fill materialization leaves a positive `water_volume_l()` but zero nitrate/alkalinity/calcium/etc. Repro: `medium_planted` with `fill_ratio=0.1`, `source_water_profile_id=None`, `substrate_preset=InertSand` produces ~0.36 L of water with all dissolved totals still at 0. Rebuild from the effective source-water profile (or at least special-case `0 -> positive` volume changes) and add a regression test for this path.
